summary.text: Ken Brass is a Democrat member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 58, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Ascension, St. James, and St. John the Baptist parishes. First elected in 2017, Ken Brass serves as vice chair of the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Ken Brass's occupation as electrical engineer at BASF, with a degree from Lutcher High School and a B.S. in electrical engineering from Southern University and A&M College (1999).

The House page lists Ken Brass's committee assignments as Ways and Means (vice chair), Natural Resources and Environment, Retirement, and Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Capital Region Legislative Delegation, Democratic Caucus, and Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus.
